title: Note rows carry a typed family marker: gate evidence, observation, and note rows are distinguishable in text and JSON by a field derived from the stored evidence kind, not by matching body text
outcome: Note rows carry a typed family marker: gate evidence, observation, and note rows are distinguishable in text and JSON by a field derived from the stored evidence kind, not by matching body text
acceptance: Each row in show --notes and --history carries its existing JSON family (notes, observations, gates, history) and a short text marker (note, observation, gate, history), derived from the stored record kind, gate structure and observation provenance; single-row --note LOCATOR detail uses the same marker; note bodies are unchanged; per-row markers agree with each family's shown count on a mixed fixture.

completion.summary: Added typed text family markers to note/history rows and detail while preserving JSON families and bodies; mixed, paged, history, placeholder and CLI/MCP coverage passes. R3 full Windows gate and Codex/Claude reviews clean; independent acceptance 1/1 pass; all three live stores ready with new build.
